name: create-issue
description: Creates an issue in a GitHub repository with a title and an optional Markdown body, labels and assignees, and answers its number, which github__get-issue and github__comment-on-issue-or-pull-request take. The owner and repository come from github__list-my-repositories.

owner.description: The repository's owner, the part before the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

repo.description: The repository's name, the part after the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.
